nodes.label: Body text background stroke and shape scope mapping

nodes.label: Bounded Body color pairing and decorative stroke rule
nodes.rationale: Product content pairs text and shape of a tone with its matching subtle background or uses primary text on subtle backgrounds. Meaning also uses text or shape. Tested pair contrast is not universal contrast between arbitrary tokens; stroke/secondary is decorative and cannot be the only control or state signal. Official Buttons, Badges and other controls keep internal roles.
